sources.h1: Cryptid Effects Indrid Cold - High-Gain Fuzz
sources.excerpt: Published on February 10, 2026 Cryptid Effects fuzz pedal Information Indrid Cold is a high-gain fuzz pedal from Cryptid Effects, designed to deliver an aggressive yet controllable fuzz voice that balances familiarity with unconventional character. The circuit combines a transistor-based fuzz core with an asymmetric soft-clipping op amp gain stage, resulting in a wide dynamic range that responds closely to pick attack and playing nuance. Despite its high-gain structure, Indrid Cold is engineered to remain exceptionally quiet when no signal is present and performs consistently with all pickup types. The fuzz stage is followed by an active tone control that allows for detailed shaping of low and high frequencies. This tone section can be completely bypassed, enabling a more direct and raw output that increases cut and immediacy in a mix. A voltage-starving sag control further expands the pedal's range, allowing the fuzz character to shift from full and saturated to broken, gated, and sputtering textures. The overall design emphasizes both tonal flexibility and practical usability in live and studio environments. Each Indrid Cold pedal is hand-wired using through-hole components in Cryptid Effects' workshop outside Austin, Texas. Construction focuses on durability, component quality, and tactile control feel, with all parts selected for long-term reliability and consistent performance. Controls Volume : Sets the master output level. Sag : Reduces circuit voltage to alter the fuzz response from full-bodied saturation to gated, collapsing textures. Bass : Adjusts low-frequency response. Treble : Adjusts high-frequency content. Tone Lift : Bypasses the active tone control for a more direct and unfiltered sound. Bypass : Engages or disengages the effect. Connections Input : Mono instrument input. Output : Mono output to amplifier or next effect. Power Input : 9V DC barrel connector, negative-tip (Boss-style). Technical Specifications Power Requirement : 9V DC, negative-tip. Current Draw : 10 mA when active. Battery Support : None. Construction : Hand-wired, through-hole components. Enclosure : Aluminum enclosure. Highlights High-gain transistor fuzz with asymmetric soft-clipping op-amp stage. Active tone control with switchable bypass. Voltage sag control for gated and sputtering fuzz textures. Quiet operation when idle and strong pickup compatibility. Hand-wired construction, with premium components in Texas.
